item.title: WithCoverage plans to grow headquarters, create 200 jobs with state subsidy
item.description: WithCoverage will create 205 jobs and invest $25 million in New York as the AI insurance firm moves its headquarters to a larger office in Hudson Square.
item.author: Emily Feil

item.title: Torrance manufacturer Hadrian raises $1.37B to build AI-powered factories
item.description: Hadrian, a Torrance-based advanced manufacturer, raises $1.37 billion to build automated factories for defense and aerospace sectors.
item.author: Isabel Sami
